changed: On the Collection and in the program editor's dance picker, Online search is now an icon at the end of the row of search tools instead of a switch inside the Advanced panel; hover over it or press and hold for its description. Filters and Advanced are greyed out while Online search is on, and a full-width source selector appears under the row.
The "Use advanced query" switch is gone: the Advanced panel's query editor is always available, and any condition you add applies straight away. To set a query aside, delete its conditions.
